mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 82 degrees with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, though it feels a bit warmer at 86 degrees, and the moon is in its third quarter phase.
The City of Verona is offering some great opportunities, including a new free tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center for scenic rides and seasonal job openings at the Recreation Department.
There is plenty to do with trivia today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring the downtown farmer's market and trivia at the Bogey Factory.
In our weekly look at police activity, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
You can enjoy the delicious Butter Pecan flavor of the day at Culver's until they close at 10 PM tonight.
